mcqs.learning_point: गोपी और कृष्ण के संबंध को समझना
mcqs.question: Surdas ke pad mein Gopi aur Krishna ke beech ka sambandh kaun sa hai?
mcqs.explanation: Surdas ke pad hamesha Gopi aur Krishna ke beech ke prem aur lagav ko dikhate hain, jo bhakti aur vatsalya ka pratinidhitva karta hai. 'Shatru', 'Mitra' ya 'Vyavaharik' sambandh pad ki bhavna se mel nahi khate.

mcqs.learning_point: वात्सल्य और प्रेम की अभिव्यक्ति पहचानना
mcqs.question: Surdas ke pad mein vatsalya aur prem ki abhivyakti kaun se chitr ya shabd se pradarshit hoti hai?
mcqs.explanation: Krishna ke bal roop, makhan chori, bansuri bajana aadi chitr Surdas ke pad mein vatsalya aur prem ki sabse pramukh abhivyakti hain. Anya vikalp pad ki bhavna se sambandhit nahi hain.

mcqs.learning_point: ब्रज संस्कृति और लोकजीवन को समझना
mcqs.question: Brij sanskriti aur lok jeevan ka varnan Surdas ke pad mein kis roop mein hota hai?

options.B: Gaon ki parampara, rasleela, melas aur madhur bhakti

mcqs.answer: Gaon ki parampara, rasleela, melas aur madhur bhakti
mcqs.explanation: Surdas ke pad Brij ki gaon ki parampara, rasleela, melas, aur madhur bhakti ko vivid roop se darshate hain. Shahri, videshi ya industrial varnan is sandarbh mein upyukt nahi hain.

mcqs.learning_point: सूरदास की भाषा और काव्य-शैली पहचानना
mcqs.question: Surdas ki kavya shaili ki visheshta kaun si hai jo padon mein pratyaksh hoti hai?

options.B: Braj Bhasha ka madhur aur saral prayog

mcqs.answer: Braj Bhasha ka madhur aur saral prayog
mcqs.explanation: Surdas Braj Bhasha ka madhur, saral aur layapurn prayog karte hain, jo unke padon ko lokpriya banata hai. Sadhu bhasha, shuddh Sanskrit ya Angrezi iske virudh hain.

mcqs.question: Nimnalikhit pad ka kendriya bhav kya hai? "Madhur milan ki baat, Gopi ke sang, Krishna ki leela anand ki"
mcqs.explanation: Yah pad Krishna ke bal roop aur Gopi ke saath uske rasleela ko darshata hai, jo mukhya roop se vatsalya aur prem ka bhav vyakt karta hai. Veer, shok ya krodh is sandarbh mein upyukt nahi hain.

mcqs.learning_point: कृष्ण के बाल रूप का चित्रण समझना
mcqs.question: Agar ek bachcha Vrindavan mein Krishna ko bansuri bajate aur makhan chori karte dekhe, to Surdas ke pad ke anusar Krishna ka varnan kaun sa hoga?

options.B: Mischievous bal roop jo makhan chori karta hai

mcqs.answer: Mischievous bal roop jo makhan chori karta hai
mcqs.explanation: Surdas Krishna ko bachpan mein makhan chori, bansuri bajane aur rasleela mein bhag lene wale mischievous bal roop ke roop mein darshate hain. Yoddha, guru ya raja ka varnan is pad ke sandarbh se bahar hai.

mcqs.learning_point: गोपी और कृष्ण के संबंध को समझना
mcqs.question: Surdas ke pad ke sandarbh mein Gopi‑Krishna sambandh ke baare mein kaun si baat galat dharna (misconception) hai?

options.A: Yeh sambandh keval prem aur romantic bhavana par aadharit hai
options.B: Yeh sambandh bhakti aur divya prem ka pratinidhitva karta hai
options.C: Yeh sambandh mitrata aur sahyog par adharit hai
options.D: Yeh sambandh bhakti ke madhyam se aatma‑santosh deta hai

mcqs.answer: Yeh sambandh keval prem aur romantic bhavana par aadharit hai
mcqs.explanation: Surdas ke pad mein Gopi‑Krishna ka sambandh bhakti, divya prem aur vatsalya par aadharit hai, na ki keval romantic prem. Isliye option A galat dharna ko darshata hai, jabki B, C, D sahi arth ko vyakt karte hain.

mcqs.learning_point: वात्सल्य और प्रेम की अभिव्यक्ति पहचानना
mcqs.question: Surdas ke pad mein vatsalya aur prem ki abhivyakti ko shringara se alag kyun maana jata hai?

options.A: Kyonki yah parental ya pitritva ki bhavana ko darshata hai
options.B: Kyonki yah erotic ya kaamuk bhavana ko vyakt karta hai
options.C: Kyonki yah krodh aur virodh ko darshata hai
options.D: Kyonki yah bhay aur sankat ko pradarshit karta hai

mcqs.answer: Kyonki yah parental ya pitritva ki bhavana ko darshata hai
mcqs.explanation: Vatsalya bhakti mein Krishna ke prati pitritva ya maa‑jaise prem ko darshata hai, jo shringara (erotic) bhavana se alag hota hai. Isliye option A sahi hai; anya vikalp vatsalya ki mool bhavna ko galat vyakhya karte hain.
